title: Configuration expansion at an input index
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state binary Turing machine, let $\ell$ be a finite list of bit sources, let $T,t\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $w$ be a finite binary word. For every $p\in\mathbb{N}$ with $p<|\ell|+2$, the configuration expansion at the index assigned to time $t$ and input position $p$ equals the input-position expansion for $M,w,t,p$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state binary Turing machine
$\ell$ is a finite list of bit sources
